messages:
deploybot: [deploy] starting regional rollout -> prod
- tag: release-2.14.0
- commit: abc1234def
- path: /services/inference
- order: US -> EU -> APAC
- change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC
- canary: 1% in US

maria-plat: thanks, are we doing version pinning if any regressions appear? :eyes:

kevin-sre: plan is canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%, with automatic rollback to previous tag on >=5% 5xxs in 5m. manual pin available if needed. @maria-plat

jen-product: seeing a bump in EU 500s in dashboards, started ~+90s after EU canary rolled up. not huge but above baseline.

kevin-sre: digging into logs now, reproducing a latency spike in tokenizer path. tagging @oncall-bob in case we need to pause APAC before lift-off.

deploybot: update: US -> 1% ✅
EU -> 1% ⏳ (observed elevated 500s)
APAC -> queued ⏸️

evin-sre: recommend pausing EU ramp and pin EU to release-2.13.2 while we investigate. effects are isolated to a model shard. will open quick rollback ticket.

maria-plat: agree with pin for EU. keep US ramping if healthy.

oncall-bob: opening incident/rollback ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INC-4921. Notifying support and customers in impacted EU region.

deploybot: actioning: pin EU -> release-2.13.2 (tag: release-2.13.2). EU traffic cut to previous variant.

deploybot: status check (approx):
```
US: 10% -> healthy (latency stable)
EU: pinned -> release-2.13.2 (traffic diverted)
APAC: hold (0%)
```

jen-product: thanks, will update release notes and comms. tagging PMs.

kevin-sre: will keep investigating model shard mismatch. if root cause found, we can re-roll EU patch build and resume.

deploybot: final update: US rollout complete 100% ✅
EU pinned to release-2.13.2 and paused for patch ✅/⏸️
APAC rollout remains on hold pending manual approval ⏸️
Rollout result: partial success. See incident/rollback INC-4921 for details.

maria-plat: good catch. debrief after we have a patch and postmortem notes.

oncall-bob: I'll coordinate customer comms and ETA once kevin confirms fix.
